title: Real world outcomes of Kahook Dual Blade goniotomy in black and Afro-Latinx adult patients with glaucoma: a 2-year retrospective study

license.statement: CC BY, version not stated (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY))

indication: open-angle glaucoma (including NTG, JOAG and secondary OAG) in Black and Afro-Latinx adults; retrospective, single surgeon

groups.description: phacoemulsification followed by 120-degree Kahook Dual Blade goniotomy (phakic eyes)
standalone 120-degree Kahook Dual Blade goniotomy (pseudophakic eyes)

extraction_decision: no admissible series; no record built

exclusions.what: Table 2 KDB/phaco series (R7-R8, C2-C5: pre-operative, day 1, 1 year, 2 years)
exclusions.reason: outcome-selected analysis set (protocol inclusion 4): the Discussion states that 11 of the initial 64 eyes needed additional surgery and were removed from the analysis; the analysed eyes are the remaining eyes with two-year follow-up, i.e. eyes without additional glaucoma surgery
same outcome-selected analysis set (eyes needing additional surgery removed)
whole cohort of the two subgroups (would duplicate the same eyes) and the same outcome-selected analysis set

exclusions.what: Table 2 P value rows (R5, R9, R13)

exclusions.reason: medication data are notes only; same outcome-selected analysis set

notes: Per-visit eye counts in Table 2 are identical at every visit, consistent with an analysis restricted to eyes completing two years without additional surgery.
Tonometer is not named in the article.
All glaucoma medications were discontinued postoperatively and restarted if needed (Procedure section).
